title: Production-grade rayx-signalr: typed errors, all transports, proxies, refreshable auth, suspension-aware liveness, proven TLS paths, reference-class performance, and stretch SOCKS/PAC/OS proxies, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3

New `log_policy_` test: a payload marker never appears in records at `debug` or above.
New `robustness_` property tests for record splitting, varint framing, envelope decoders, handshake and negotiate parsing.

sprints.title: Measurement: micro-benchmarks, reference-client performance harness, sequence tracing

tasks.title: Criterion hot-path benchmarks
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `criterion` (dev), the non-default `bench-internals` feature with `#[doc(hidden)] pub mod bench_support` exposing the current codec/storage entry points, and `benches/hot_paths.rs` with the stable ids of R1.C1 over pre-built frames for every message type, protocol and payload size. Do not change hot-path code in this sprint: S3 saves its baseline from this state.

tasks.title: Aspire performance harness with the official .NET client
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `PerfHub` to the test service, the `perf` test-false binary in `tests/perf` (one workload per run, JSON result line, release build), `dotnet/RayX.SignalR.PerfReference` (official client, same CLI), the `Performance` category in the E2E project (interleaved rounds, median, `artifacts-temp/perf/<run>.json`, `RAYX_SIGNALR_PERF_WORKLOADS`/`RAYX_SIGNALR_PERF_SCALE`), and add the new project to `RayX.SignalR.slnx`. Performance tests never run in the ordinary E2E selection.

tasks.title: Stateful sequence instrumentation
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `debug` sequencing records of D3 to `stateful.rs` and the reconnect/resume paths on both targets (generation, tracked/received ids, duplicates, Acks, Sequence, resend range; no payloads), and the `sequence_trace_` unit group with a capturing logger.

tasks.title: Error type and classification
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `src/error.rs` per D12 (`Error`, `ErrorKind`, structured accessors, `is_transient`, `Arc` sources, redaction at construction) with `thiserror`, and the `error_model_` group.

tasks.title: Typed public API on both targets
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Replace every `String` error on paths reaching the public API (client, invocations, streams, lifecycle, configuration validation, handlers via `ReconnectionHandler::reason()`, TLS/Android initialization) on native and wasm; add `tests/public_error_types.rs`.

tasks.title: Error-kinds scenario and test migration
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the service endpoints needed by `error-kinds` (throwing hub method, unknown path, hang endpoint if not yet present, close-with-error) and the scenario in `tests/e2e` and the wasm fixture; migrate existing scenarios and unit tests from string matching to kinds; prove the whole WebSocket catalog on native and Chromium.

tasks.title: Error documentation and major version
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Errors chapter (`docs/11-errors-and-logging.md`) with the migration section, per-item error docs, next major version in `Cargo.toml` per R12.C4.

tasks.title: Disconnect stops every handle (StopAsync parity)
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Split `Communication::disconnect` (unconditional local close) from `release` (drop: last handle only); make `SignalRClient::disconnect` take `&self`; add the `disconnect_` unit group and the `disconnect-every-handle` scenario (native, fixture, Playwright, catalog); change `concurrency-and-clones` to drop a clone; restore R12.C3's invoke-after-disconnect case; update the lifecycle, callbacks and errors chapters and the skill references. Review repair S2-F1: the native action storage releases its map lock before an action runs (each action has its own lock, as the browser storage already did), so `disconnect`/`register`/`unregister` inside a callback return; `disconnect_` covers it and the last-handle drop, and `disconnect-every-handle` has a server-triggered callback that disconnects.

sprints.title: Hot-path optimization: single-pass codec, quiet logging, panic-free parsing

tasks.title: Single-pass inbound and typed outbound codec
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Run the required `s3-micro-budget` baseline first (saves `pre-optimization`). Implement `protocol::codec` per D2 (`serde_json` `raw_value`, MessagePack marker reads without `rmpv` trees), route storage/actions/callbacks through `InboundMessage`, make outbound messages typed with reused buffers and shared `Bytes`, remove `json_frame` re-parsing, and add the `wire_codec_` group. Golden frame tests stay unchanged.

tasks.title: Payload-free logging
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Remove payloads from every record above `trace` on both targets (completions, stream items, invocations, callbacks, frames) and add the `log_policy_` capturing-logger test.

tasks.title: Panic-free parsing and property tests
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `proptest` (dev), module-level `#![deny(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic, clippy::indexing_slicing)]` (outside `cfg(test)`) to the protocol, transport and negotiation modules, fix every finding, and add the `robustness_` property group.

tasks.title: Meet the micro and reference-client budgets
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `MicroBenchmarkBudget` and `ReferenceClientBudget` categories. Profile (release, `cargo flamegraph` or `perf` where available) and remove remaining per-message costs until R2.C3 and R2.C4 hold: e.g. avoid per-message `String` allocation for ids, avoid channel hops between receiver and storage, batch writer flushes, size buffers from the frame length. If a budget proves unreachable for a measured, explained reason, amend the criterion with that evidence rather than weakening silently.

sprints.title: Stability: soak/chaos harness and stateful-resume stall resolution

tasks.title: Chaos controls and soak scenario
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the test-only `ChaosControl`, `ChaosHub` and `StatefulChaosHub` to the service, the hidden alive-task counter, the `soak-chaos` scenario in `tests/e2e` and the wasm fixture (Chromium), the per-scenario catalog bound (`soak + 60 s`) and `RAYX_SIGNALR_SOAK_SECONDS` forwarding in every runner. Fix every defect the soak finds, each with its own unit regression test in a new `soak_regression_` group (amend the plan with its check).

tasks.title: Stateful-resume stress and stall resolution
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `stateful-resume-stress` (five fresh stateful connections x 100 aborts, each followed by an invocation and a short stream, sequence tracing at `debug` captured into cell diagnostics). If a stall reproduces, fix the cause with a `stateful_regression_` unit group (amend the plan with its check). Update `interop-validation/hypotheses.md` and the limitations chapter (`docs/12-limitations.md`) per R3.C4.

tasks.title: Access-token factory
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `with_access_token_factory` on both targets per D4 (per negotiate cycle, not on live stateful resume, redirect tokens win, redacted errors, conflicts rejected before I/O), the token endpoints and `TokenHub` in the service, the `access_token_factory_` group and the `token-factory` scenario (native, fixture, Android).

tasks.title: Browser Basic rejected before I/O
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the shared configuration validation function, apply the browser Basic rule on wasm, update the browser `authentication` scenario to Bearer, add the negotiate counter and the `browser-basic-rejected` scenario, and the `browser_basic_` group.

tasks.title: Configurable connect timeout and bounded browser negotiate
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: S2.T3 already replaced `CONNECT_TIMEOUT` with `with_connect_timeout` (validated nonzero, bounding negotiate and transport setup on both targets), bounded the browser negotiate `fetch` with an `AbortController`, and added `/test-hang/negotiate`, because R12.C3's `error-kinds` scenario needs the 2 s negotiate bound. This task adds the `connect_timeout_` group, keeps the timeout error free of the URL and token, and adds the `negotiate-timeout` scenario (native, fixture, Android).

sprints.title: Transport abstraction, selection and catalog transport dimension

tasks.title: Verify server transport behavior
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Before restructuring, confirm with a throwaway probe (not committed) how ASP.NET Core 10 negotiates `useStatefulReconnect` and transfer formats for Server-Sent Events and Long Polling; if stateful reconnect works there, amend R5/D5 before continuing. Then add `Transports`/`TransferFormat`, the shared configuration validation for transports, and the selection/fallback logic in `negotiation.rs` with the `transport_selection_` group.

tasks.title: WebSockets behind the transport abstraction
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Introduce the per-target `Transport` enum and sender/receiver pair per D5, move the WebSocket code behind it on both targets (browser keeps `browser_socket.rs`), and make the connection loop transport-independent. Behavior stays identical; prove it with the whole WebSocket catalog on native and Chromium.

tasks.title: Catalog transport dimension
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `RAYX_SIGNALR_E2E_TRANSPORTS` to selection, the transport-baseline marking, cell generation and naming per D6, `RAYX_SIGNALR_TRANSPORT` forwarding in native/mobile runners and the `transport` page parameter in the fixture/Playwright specs, `with_transports` application in `tests/e2e/support.rs` and the fixture, the restricted service hubs, and `TransportCatalogTests`.

tasks.title: Long Polling on both targets
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement Long Polling per D5/D7: native over the crate's hyper connector (poll + send connections), browser over `fetch` with `AbortController` and non-shared binary copies; ordered batched POST sends; DELETE on close; `with_long_polling_timeout`. Add the `long_polling_` group including `robustness_long_polling_` property tests, then pass the Long Polling baseline on native, every browser engine and Android.

sprints.title: Server-Sent Events transport and proven fallback

tasks.title: Server-Sent Events on both targets
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement Server-Sent Events per D5/D7: native streaming GET with the event-stream parser, browser `EventSource` wrapper (auto-reconnect disabled), shared ordered POST sends, MessagePack rejected before I/O. Add the `server_sent_events_` group including `robustness_server_sent_events_`, then pass the Server-Sent Events baseline on native, every browser engine and Android.

tasks.title: Transport fallback end to end
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `/test-longpolling` and `/test-no-websockets` hubs (if not added in S6) and the `transport-fallback` scenario (native, fixture, Android) asserting the chosen transport through `TransportDetails` and the WebSockets-only failure message.

tasks.title: Proxy configuration and CONNECT tunnel
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `ProxyConfig`, `with_proxy`/`with_system_proxy`/`without_proxy` (native only), environment resolution with `NO_PROXY` matching, the CONNECT handshake in the shared native connector for negotiate and every transport, TLS inside the tunnel with the connection's rustls configuration, redaction, and the `proxy_` group.

tasks.title: Aspire test proxy and proxy scenario
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `dotnet/RayX.SignalR.TestProxy` (CONNECT, tunnel counter, credentials, deny list, `/stats`) as an Aspire resource on a dynamic port, peer recording in the service, and the `proxy` scenario covering plaintext and TLS over all three transports, 407 and `NO_PROXY` bypass (native, Android).

tasks.title: Suspension detection in the liveness scheduler
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `Clock` abstraction and the lateness/wall-clock suspension check of D9 to the shared scheduler on both targets, wired to the existing Ping and dropped-transport paths, with the `suspension_` group (injected clock).

tasks.title: Suspend-resume scenario and runner controls
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the readiness line and the `suspend-resume` scenario (native, fixture, Android), runner suspension controls (Windows `NtSuspendProcess` P/Invoke, Unix/iOS `SIGSTOP`/`SIGCONT`, Android `kill -STOP/-CONT`, Chromium CDP `Page.setWebLifecycleState`), the 120 s catalog bound and the Firefox/WebKit exclusion reason.

tasks.title: App lifecycle documentation
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Document iOS, Android and browser lifecycle integration and suspension detection in `docs/06-connection-lifecycle.md` and `docs/09-platforms.md` per R9.C3.

sprints.title: Stretch: SOCKS5, proxy auto-config and OS proxy settings

tasks.title: SOCKS5 proxies
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the SOCKS5 route and URL schemes per D13 to the shared connector, the SOCKS5 listener in the test proxy, the `socks_` group and the `proxy-socks` scenario. Stretch rule: start with a time-boxed feasibility check; if infeasible, stop and ask the user before dropping criteria through `amend --specification` with the evidence (see scope).

tasks.title: Proxy auto-config
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `proxy-pac` feature with the bounded PAC evaluator and helpers per D13, PAC endpoints in the test proxy, the `pac_` group and the `proxy-pac` scenario. Stretch rule: start with a time-boxed feasibility check; if infeasible, stop and ask the user before dropping criteria through `amend --specification` with the evidence (see scope).

tasks.title: OS proxy settings
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `with_os_proxy()` with the WinHTTP, CFNetwork, Android `ProxySelector` and Linux readers per D13, the `os_proxy_` group, and the `os-proxy` scenario with runner-managed settings (emulator; CI-only opt-in for Windows and macOS). Stretch rule: start with a time-boxed feasibility check; if infeasible, stop and ask the user before dropping criteria through `amend --specification` with the evidence (see scope).

tasks.title: HTTP/2 client paths
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `with_http_version`, ALPN/h2c selection, multiplexed reuse for negotiate/Long Polling/Server-Sent Events and RFC 8441 WebSockets per D14, with the `http2_` group. Stretch rule: start with a time-boxed feasibility check; if infeasible, stop and ask the user before dropping criteria through `amend --specification` with the evidence (see scope).

tasks.title: HTTP/2 service endpoints and scenario
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the HTTP/2 and h2c Kestrel endpoints with protocol recording and the `http2` scenario.

tasks.title: HTTP/3 client paths
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Verify Kestrel RFC 9220 support first and record it (amend D15 if needed); add the `http3` feature, `Http3`/`Http3Preferred`, QUIC with the connection TLS configuration, and the `http3_` group. Stretch rule: start with a time-boxed feasibility check; if infeasible, stop and ask the user before dropping criteria through `amend --specification` with the evidence (see scope).

tasks.title: HTTP/3 service endpoint and scenario
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the msquic-detected Kestrel HTTP/3 endpoint, catalog exclusions for unsupported hosts and the `http3` scenario.

sprints.title: CI, documentation and a green run

tasks.title: Workflows for every new dimension
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Update `e2e.yml` (all transports, `android-app`, `tls-aws-lc (<target>)`, nightly/dispatch `soak`) and add `perf.yml`; extend `WorkflowContract` per job. Include the `error-kinds` scenario in every e2e job and the delivered stretch dimensions (SOCKS5/PAC with the proxy scenarios, `os-proxy (windows, macos)` with `RAYX_SIGNALR_E2E_ALLOW_SYSTEM_CHANGES=1`, HTTP/2, HTTP/3 on ubuntu with `libmsquic` and windows).

tasks.title: Documentation and memory
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write the `docs/` chapters, the measured performance summary from the `perf / compare` report, the remaining the limitations chapter (`docs/12-limitations.md`) residual risks, the testing chapter (`docs/14-testing.md`), and memory updates per R11.C3. Prepare the paired consumer changes for the final public API (RayX `rayx_devkit::SignalRService` and RayX.GameX `gamex_sbk_services` still return `Result<_, String>` around `connect`), validate their affected crates, and hand them to the user for merging with the epic branch; the user explicitly chose on 2026-10-07 to update the consumers once at the end of the epic rather than per sprint (CLAUDE.md consumer rule; the consumer repositories are not epic execution repositories).

tasks.title: Green GitHub Actions run
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Push the epic branch only after the user confirms, run every workflow plus dispatched `soak` and `perf / compare`, repair failures (batched), and record the run URLs for the final review.
